BIRCH AND SWINNERTON-DYER · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE DIVISION AT ORDER ONE · THE VALUE IS EXACTLY ITS REAL PART AND ITS UNICORN PART

The cut at every order
The value is exactly its real part and its unicorn part.
